column7: unique document identifier (e.g., DOC001, DOC002). Used to track which policy document a row belongs to.
the format/category of the document. Common values include TXT, PDF, DOCX, HTML, Word, Markdown. Determines how the document is loaded during ingestion.
unique identifier for a text chunk within a document. Format: {filename}_page{N}_chunk{M}. Used for tracking source provenance in the RAG pipeline.
the number of words in a document chunk. Used for analyzing document length vs. retrieval/answer quality relationships.
a numerical score indicating how relevant a retrieved chunk is to a query, typically based on vector similarity (cosine distance). Higher scores indicate better relevance.
the category of question being asked. Common types include factual, analytical, comparative, procedural, and summarization. Affects expected answer format and quality.
a numerical score (0-1 or 0-100) indicating the quality of the answer, typically based on human review or automated metrics like faithfulness, completeness, and correctness.
